tools.name: list_vms
tools.title: List VMs
tools.description: List ALL virtual machines on Nutanix (auto-paginates internally). Returns complete results in one call — no manual pagination needed. Use 'cluster_name' to filter VMs to a specific cluster by name. Use 'filter' to narrow results via OData. Use 'limit' only if you want a subset.

cluster_name.description: Filter VMs to a specific cluster by name (client-side filtering).

filter.description: OData filter expression. Examples: "name eq 'my-vm'", "powerState eq 'ON'"

limit.description: Optional cap on results. Omit to get ALL VMs (default behavior).

tools.name: get_vm
tools.title: Get VM
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific VM by its UUID. Returns full configuration including CPU, memory, disks, and NICs.

vm_uuid.description: The UUID (extId) of the virtual machine

tools.name: power_on_vm
tools.title: Power On VM
tools.description: Power on a virtual machine.

vm_uuid.description: The UUID (extId) of the virtual machine

tools.name: power_off_vm
tools.title: Power Off VM
tools.description: Power off a virtual machine. Uses ACPI shutdown by default (guest-initiated).

vm_uuid.description: The UUID (extId) of the virtual machine

force.description: Force power off (hard shutdown) instead of ACPI guest shutdown

tools.name: create_vm
tools.title: Create VM
tools.description: Create a new virtual machine. Requires name, cluster UUID, and basic specs.

cluster_uuid.description: UUID of the cluster to create the VM on

tools.name: update_vm
tools.title: Update VM
tools.description: Update a virtual machine's configuration (CPU, memory, name, description). The VM should be powered off for CPU/memory changes. Uses ETag-based concurrency control. Returns a task UUID for status tracking.

vm_uuid.description: The UUID (extId) of the virtual machine to update

num_vcpus.description: New total number of vCPUs (optional, VM must be off)

memory_mb.description: New memory in MB (optional, VM must be off)

tools.name: delete_vm
tools.title: Delete VM
tools.description: Delete a virtual machine permanently. This action cannot be undone. Requires explicit confirmation. Returns a task UUID for status tracking.

vm_uuid.description: The UUID (extId) of the virtual machine to delete

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm deletion. Safety guard against accidental deletes.

tools.name: clone_vm
tools.title: Clone VM
tools.description: Clone an existing virtual machine. Creates a copy with a new name. Returns a task UUID for status tracking.

vm_uuid.description: The UUID (extId) of the source VM to clone

tools.name: list_clusters
tools.title: List Clusters
tools.description: List ALL Nutanix clusters registered with Prism Central (auto-paginates internally). Returns complete results in one call — no manual pagination needed.

tools.name: get_cluster
tools.title: Get Cluster
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific cluster by UUID. Returns configuration, network, storage, and health details.

tools.name: list_hosts
tools.title: List Hosts
tools.description: List ALL hypervisor hosts (auto-paginates internally). Returns complete results in one call — no manual pagination needed. Optionally filter by cluster UUID.

cluster_uuid.description: Filter hosts to a specific cluster UUID

limit.description: Optional cap on results. Omit to get ALL hosts (default behavior).

tools.name: get_host
tools.title: Get Host
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific host by UUID. Returns hardware specs, hypervisor info, and resource usage.

tools.name: list_storage_containers
tools.title: List Storage Containers
tools.description: List ALL storage containers (auto-paginates internally). Returns complete results in one call — no manual pagination needed.

cluster_uuid.description: Filter to a specific cluster UUID

limit.description: Optional cap on results. Omit to get ALL containers (default behavior).

tools.name: create_storage_container
tools.title: Create Storage Container
tools.description: Create a storage container on a cluster. Containers thin-provision against the cluster's storage pool, so capacity settings are optional. Optionally set replication factor, an advertised (logical) capacity cap, an explicit reservation, and inline compression. Returns a task UUID.

cluster_uuid.description: UUID (extId) of the cluster to create the container on.

replication_factor.description: Replication factor (1, 2, or 3). Must not exceed the cluster's RF. Default: cluster default.

advertised_capacity_gb.description: Optional advertised (logical) capacity cap, in GiB.

reserved_capacity_gb.description: Optional explicit reserved (guaranteed) capacity, in GiB.

compression_enabled.description: Enable inline compression. Default: cluster default.

tools.name: resize_storage_container
tools.title: Resize Storage Container
tools.description: Resize or reconfigure a storage container: change its advertised (logical) capacity cap, explicit reservation, name, or compression setting. Uses ETag-based concurrency control. Returns a task UUID.

container_uuid.description: The UUID (extId) of the storage container.

advertised_capacity_gb.description: New advertised (logical) capacity cap, in GiB.

reserved_capacity_gb.description: New explicit reserved (guaranteed) capacity, in GiB.

tools.name: delete_storage_container
tools.title: Delete Storage Container
tools.description: Delete a storage container by UUID. Requires confirm=true to proceed. Uses ETag-based concurrency control. Returns a task UUID. Fails if the container still holds vdisks/VMs unless ignore_small_files is set.

container_uuid.description: The UUID (extId) of the storage container to delete.

confirm.description: Must be true to proceed with deletion.

ignore_small_files.description: Allow deletion even if the container holds small files. Default: false.

tools.name: pe_get_cluster_info
tools.title: PE: Get Cluster Info
tools.description: Get cluster info directly from a Prism Element node. Returns AOS version, cluster name, storage capacity, and health.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_list_vms
tools.title: PE: List VMs
tools.description: List VMs on a specific Prism Element cluster. Returns VM names, UUIDs, power states, and resource allocation.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

count.description: Maximum number of VMs to return

tools.name: pe_list_hosts
tools.title: PE: List Hosts
tools.description: List hypervisor hosts on a Prism Element cluster. Returns host names, IPs, hardware specs, and CVM info.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_list_containers
tools.title: PE: List Containers
tools.description: List storage containers on a Prism Element cluster. Returns names, capacity, usage, replication factor, and policies.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_list_storage_pools
tools.title: PE: List Storage Pools
tools.description: List storage pools on a Prism Element cluster. Returns pool names, capacity, and disk composition.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_list_disks
tools.title: PE: List Disks
tools.description: List physical disks on a Prism Element cluster. Returns disk type (SSD/HDD), status, capacity, and location.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_list_alerts
tools.title: PE: List Alerts
tools.description: List alerts on a Prism Element cluster. Returns alert titles, severity, timestamps, and affected entities.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

resolved.description: Include resolved alerts (default: false, only active)

count.description: Maximum number of alerts to return (default: 50)

tools.name: pe_list_protection_domains
tools.title: PE: List Protection Domains
tools.description: List protection domains on a Prism Element cluster. Returns PD names, protected entities, schedules, and replication state.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_list_snapshots
tools.title: PE: List Snapshots
tools.description: List snapshots for a protection domain on a Prism Element cluster.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_get_auth_config
tools.title: PE: Get Auth Config
tools.description: Get authentication configuration from a Prism Element cluster. Returns auth types, directory services (LDAP/AD), and local account settings.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_get_smtp_config
tools.title: PE: Get SMTP Config
tools.description: Get SMTP server configuration from a Prism Element cluster. Returns relay server, port, sender address, and security settings.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_get_snmp_config
tools.title: PE: Get SNMP Config
tools.description: Get SNMP configuration from a Prism Element cluster. Returns SNMP traps, transports, users, and community strings.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_get_syslog_config
tools.title: PE: Get Syslog Config
tools.description: Get remote syslog server configuration from a Prism Element cluster. Returns syslog targets, protocols, ports, and severity levels.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_get_alert_email_config
tools.title: PE: Get Alert Email Config
tools.description: Get alert email notification configuration from a Prism Element cluster. Returns email recipients and alert notification rules.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_get_nfs_whitelists
tools.title: PE: Get NFS Whitelists
tools.description: Get global NFS whitelist configuration from a Prism Element cluster. Returns filesystem whitelists (NFS export ACLs) for cluster-wide access control.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_get_licensing_info
tools.title: PE: Get Licensing Info
tools.description: Get licensing information from a Prism Element cluster. Returns license type (Starter/Pro/Ultimate), expiry, and enabled cluster features.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_get_protection_domain
tools.title: PE: Get Protection Domain
tools.description: Get detailed configuration of a specific protection domain. Returns consistency groups, VM list, schedules, and replication config.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_list_remote_sites
tools.title: PE: List Remote Sites
tools.description: List remote sites (DR partner clusters) on a Prism Element cluster. Returns remote site names, addresses, replication bandwidth, and capabilities.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_get_replication_status
tools.title: PE: Get Replication Status
tools.description: Get active replication status for a protection domain. Returns current replications, lag, and bandwidth usage.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_list_unprotected_vms
tools.title: PE: List Unprotected VMs
tools.description: List VMs not in any protection domain on a Prism Element cluster. Identifies compliance gaps where VMs lack DR protection.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_get_host_disks
tools.title: PE: Get Host Disks
tools.description: Get physical disk inventory for a specific host. Returns disk model, serial number, firmware, tier (SSD/HDD), status, and capacity.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

host_uuid.description: UUID of the host to get disk inventory for

tools.name: pe_get_host_nics
tools.title: PE: Get Host NICs
tools.description: Get network interface details for a specific host. Returns NIC name, speed, link state, MAC address, and switch info via LLDP.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

host_uuid.description: UUID of the host to get NIC details for

tools.name: pe_list_cvms
tools.title: PE: List CVMs
tools.description: List Controller VMs (CVMs) on a Prism Element cluster. Returns CVM IP, memory allocation, power state, and associated host.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_list_volume_groups
tools.title: PE: List Volume Groups
tools.description: List volume groups on a Prism Element cluster. Returns VG name, size, iSCSI target IQN, attached VMs, and CHAP config.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_get_volume_group
tools.title: PE: Get Volume Group
tools.description: Get detailed volume group configuration. Returns disk list, client attachments, iSCSI details, and usage.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_get_cluster_health
tools.title: PE: Get Cluster Health
tools.description: Get cluster data resiliency and fault tolerance status. Returns per-domain (NODE, RACKABLE_UNIT, RACK, DISK) fault tolerance: how many failures each component can tolerate, and an explanatory message when it cannot.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_list_health_checks
tools.title: PE: List Health Checks
tools.description: List NCC-style health check results on a Prism Element cluster. Returns check names, statuses, and any warnings or failures.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_list_images
tools.title: PE: List Images
tools.description: List images (ISOs, disk images) on a Prism Element cluster. Returns image name, type, state, size, and source URI.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_list_networks
tools.title: PE: List Networks
tools.description: List networks (VLANs) on a Prism Element cluster. Returns network name, VLAN ID, managed/unmanaged state, and IP pool configuration.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_get_metro_witness
tools.title: PE: Get Metro Witness
tools.description: Get Metro Availability witness server configuration. Returns witness address, status, and cluster association.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_list_dr_snapshots
tools.title: PE: List DR Snapshots
tools.description: List disaster recovery snapshots across remote sites. Returns snapshot IDs, PD names, remote site, and retention info.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: pe_list_pd_replications
tools.title: PE: List PD Replications
tools.description: List all active protection domain replications across the cluster. Returns replication status, progress, bandwidth, and remote site for all PDs.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP address or hostname

tools.name: list_subnets
tools.title: List Subnets
tools.description: List ALL subnets/VLANs in Prism Central (auto-paginates internally). Returns complete results in one call — no manual pagination needed.

filter.description: OData filter expression. Examples: "name eq 'production-vlan'", "vlanId eq 100"

limit.description: Optional cap on results. Omit to get ALL subnets (default behavior).

tools.name: get_subnet
tools.title: Get Subnet
tools.description: Get detailed subnet configuration including IP pools, DHCP config, and virtual switch assignment.

tools.name: create_subnet
tools.title: Create Subnet
tools.description: Create a VLAN-backed subnet on a cluster. Provide the VLAN id and target cluster UUID. Optionally enable IPAM (a managed subnet) by supplying a network CIDR, default gateway, and a DHCP pool range. Returns a task UUID.

cluster_uuid.description: UUID (extId) of the cluster to create the subnet on.

vlan_id.description: VLAN ID (use 0 for the untagged/native VLAN).

network_cidr.description: Optional. Enables IPAM. Network in CIDR form, e.g. '10.0.1.0/24'.

dhcp_pool_start.description: Optional DHCP/managed pool start IP (requires network_cidr).

dhcp_pool_end.description: Optional DHCP/managed pool end IP (requires network_cidr).

tools.name: update_subnet
tools.title: Update Subnet
tools.description: Update an existing subnet's configuration (name, description, VLAN id, or IPAM settings). Uses ETag-based concurrency control. Returns a task UUID.

subnet_uuid.description: The UUID (extId) of the subnet to update.

network_cidr.description: Set/replace the IPAM network CIDR, e.g. '10.0.1.0/24'.

gateway_ip.description: Set the default gateway IP (requires network_cidr).

tools.name: delete_subnet
tools.title: Delete Subnet
tools.description: Delete a subnet by UUID. Requires confirm=true to proceed. Uses ETag-based concurrency control. Returns a task UUID. Fails if VMs still use the subnet.

subnet_uuid.description: The UUID (extId) of the subnet to delete.

confirm.description: Must be true to proceed with deletion.

tools.name: list_images
tools.title: List Images
tools.description: List ALL disk images (ISOs, QCOW2) in the image library (auto-paginates internally). Returns complete results in one call — no manual pagination needed.

filter.description: OData filter expression. Examples: "name eq 'ubuntu-22.04'", "type eq 'DISK_IMAGE'"

limit.description: Optional cap on results. Omit to get ALL images (default behavior).

tools.name: get_image
tools.title: Get Image
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific disk image by UUID. Returns size, type, source, and cluster placement.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List Categories
tools.description: List ALL category keys and values (auto-paginates internally). Returns complete results in one call — no manual pagination needed.

limit.description: Optional cap on results. Omit to get ALL categories (default behavior).

tools.name: get_category
tools.title: Get Category
tools.description: Get all values for a specific category key. Example: category 'Environment' may have values 'Production', 'Dev', 'Test'.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List Tasks
tools.description: List ALL recent Nutanix tasks (auto-paginates internally). Returns complete results in one call — no manual pagination needed. Use filter to narrow by status (RUNNING, FAILED, SUCCEEDED).

filter.description: OData filter expression. Examples: "status eq 'RUNNING'", "status eq 'FAILED'", "status eq 'SUCCEEDED'"

tools.name: get_task
tools.title: Get Task
tools.description: Get detailed status of a specific task by its UUID. Returns completion percentage, status, error details, and associated entities. Use this to verify whether an async operation (VM create, power on, etc.) succeeded.

task_uuid.description: The UUID (extId) of the task to check

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.title: List Alerts
tools.description: List ALL alerts from Prism Central (auto-paginates internally). Returns complete results in one call — no manual pagination needed. Supports filtering by severity and resolved status.

resolved.description: If true, show resolved alerts. If false, show only active. Default: false (active only).

filter.description: OData filter expression for advanced filtering. Examples: "severity eq 'CRITICAL'", "creationTime gt '2026-05-01T00:00:00Z'"

tools.name: get_alert
tools.title: Get Alert
tools.description: Get full details of a specific alert by UUID. Returns affected entities, resolution guidance, parameters, and alert lifecycle information.

tools.name: acknowledge_alert
tools.title: Acknowledge Alert
tools.description: Acknowledge or resolve an alert by UUID. Acknowledging marks the alert as seen; resolving marks it as fixed.

alert_uuid.description: The UUID (extId) of the alert to acknowledge/resolve.

tools.name: assign_category
tools.title: Assign Category
tools.description: Assign a category key:value pair to a VM. Categories are Nutanix's primary mechanism for resource organization, security policy targeting (Flow microsegmentation), and DR policy assignment.

vm_uuid.description: The UUID (extId) of the VM to tag.

tools.name: remove_category
tools.title: Remove Category
tools.description: Remove a category key:value assignment from a VM. Only removes the specified category; other categories remain intact.

tools.name: list_entities_by_category
tools.title: List Entities By Category
tools.description: Find ALL VMs tagged with a specific category key:value pair (auto-paginates internally). Returns complete results in one call — no manual pagination needed.

tools.name: snapshot_vm
tools.title: Snapshot VM
tools.description: Create an on-demand snapshot (recovery point) of a VM. Returns the recovery point ID and task UUID for tracking. Use before mutating operations as a safety net.

vm_uuid.description: The UUID (extId) of the VM to snapshot.

name.description: Optional name for the recovery point. Defaults to auto-generated.

expiration_days.description: Number of days before the recovery point expires. Default: 30.

tools.name: list_vm_snapshots
tools.title: List VM Snapshots
tools.description: List recovery points (snapshots) for a specific VM. Returns up to 'limit' most relevant results (default: 20).

vm_uuid.description: The UUID (extId) of the VM whose snapshots to list.

tools.name: restore_vm_snapshot
tools.title: Restore VM Snapshot
tools.description: Restore a VM to a previous recovery point (snapshot). This reverts the VM's disks and configuration to the snapshot state. The VM should be powered off before restore.

recovery_point_id.description: The UUID of the recovery point to restore from.

vm_uuid.description: The UUID of the VM to restore.

tools.name: generate_asbuilt
tools.title: Generate AsBuilt
tools.description: Generate an infrastructure AsBuilt report from a Nutanix Prism Element cluster. Accepts a PE IP address, cluster name, or cluster UUID — cluster names and UUIDs are auto-resolved to the PE external IP via Prism Central. Queries live cluster data and returns a structured Markdown report with tables and Mermaid topology diagrams. Use 'sections' to include only specific parts. Available sections: overview, system, hosts, vms, networks, storage, protection_domains, alerts, health.

pe_host.description: Prism Element CVM IP, cluster external IP, cluster name, or cluster UUID

sections.description: Which sections to include in the report. Defaults to all sections if omitted. Options: overview, system, hosts, vms, networks, storage, protection_domains, alerts, health

tools.name: export_asbuilt_html
tools.title: Export AsBuilt HTML
tools.description: Convert an AsBuilt Markdown report to a self-contained HTML file with print-optimized CSS. Open in a browser and use Ctrl+P / Cmd+P to save as PDF. Includes Mermaid diagram rendering via CDN. Pass the markdown string from generate_asbuilt output.

markdown.description: The Markdown report content from generate_asbuilt

tools.name: get_project_architecture
tools.title: Get Project Architecture
tools.description: Get the Nutanix MCP Server project architecture documentation. Returns a Markdown document with component diagrams, API layer details, tool inventory, design decisions, deployment topology, and file structure.
